transcript.note: Round 1: target box minX=1,minY=3,maxX=9,maxY=11 (side 8) from suggest, but suggest's winding is counterclockwise while the current ring is clockwise — flipped corners would be refused. Assigned corners with the same clockwise winding: 7->(9,3) bottom-right, 11->(1,3) bottom-left, 15->(1,11) top-left, 0->(9,11) top-right; spread 6->(5,3) and 3->(5,11) onto the bottom/top sides. Ring order 14->7->6->11->4->13->15->3->0->16 now walks the square with every consecutive pair H/V (no control points). Kept hubs 4,8,16 and branches (2,10,12,5,9,1) fixed: verified cyclic neighbor order preserved around every deg>=3 hub (4:[11,8,13], 8:[4,7,16,3], 7:[2,14,8,6], 3:[8,0,5,15], 16:[14,10,12,0,8]) and interior hub 8 stays at (5,8) inside the box, so crossings stay 0.
